lines.en: I swim pressed to the big fish's flank.

lines.zh: 我的条纹在水里晃成一片。
lines.en: My stripes blur into one band.
It turns; I turn before it does.

lines.zh: 它的尾流把我推歪半尺。
lines.en: Its wake pushed me half a foot off.
I loop around its tail.
Reef ahead; I slip through the gap.
I swim fast only to keep up.
It slows, and so do I.
My fins are small but sufficient.
A shoal of my kind flickers ahead.
I steer by the light near the surface.

lines.zh: 我从它背鳍下面钻过去。
lines.en: I duck beneath its dorsal fin.
I barely rest along this route.
It heads deeper; I follow.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底游，影子先过去。
lines.en: I skim the sandy floor. My shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 转弯时我不减速，只偏一点身。
lines.en: I don't slow for turns, just tilt a little.

lines.zh: 同伴游散了，我又聚回去。
lines.en: The school scatters; I drift back together.

lines.zh: 我从沉船窗里穿进穿出。
lines.en: I thread in and out of the wreck's windows.

lines.zh: 我停在它影子里，很安全。
lines.en: I hold in its shadow, safe.
A small thing is on its hide; I peck it.

lines.zh: 我的条纹在暗处更明显。
lines.en: My stripes show more clearly in shade.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就知道它要走。
lines.en: When the water moves, I know it will go.
I flutter my tail to hold position.
A bigger fish nears; I move aside.
I am waiting for it to finish eating.

lines.zh: 它嘴边掉下碎屑，我捡了。
lines.en: Scraps fell from its mouth; I took them.
I hear the water's sounds along my flank.

lines.zh: 阳光穿水，照出我的影子。
lines.en: Sunlight through water casts my shadow.
That school is crowding too close.

lines.zh: 我转一圈，又回到它身边。
lines.en: I circled once and returned to its side.
The water is still; I hold still too.
While it rests, I keep watch.
You are much smaller than it, yet you stand.
You have no scales on you at all.
I circle you once, looking for food.

lines.zh: 你的手指在水里像小虫。
lines.en: Your fingers in the water look like worms.

lines.zh: 我不靠太近，它就在旁边。
lines.en: I keep back; it is right beside you.
You are watching the big fish too.

lines.zh: 我的条纹能骗过你的眼睛。
lines.en: My stripes can fool your eyes.
Move once and I retreat a foot.

lines.zh: 那个水桶，我在礁边见过。
lines.en: That bucket; I saw it by the reef.

lines.zh: 我躲进它影子里再看你。
lines.en: I slip into its shadow and look again.
It hurt; I shot far away.

lines.zh: 我的条纹被蹭掉两片鳞。
lines.en: Two scales scraped off along my stripes.
I circled half around before daring to return.

lines.zh: 这一下比礁石撞得还重。
lines.en: Heavier than a knock against the reef.
I dare not cry; noise draws eyes.
Some of that blood is mine.
I press against the big fish to hide.
It will not shield me; I must hide myself.
I shake my fins and steady.
Stop hitting; I am too small for this.
Scraps of meat; I am coming.
I do not grab; I let it eat first.
What you threw is too small.
I smell worms; better than meat.
I hover by its mouth for falling bits.

lines.zh: 你晃那块肉，我就跟着晃。
lines.en: Wave that meat and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 我不咬手，只咬掉下来的。
lines.en: I bite falling bits, never hands.

lines.zh: 这一口我要抢在同伴前。
lines.en: I must beat my shoal to this bite.
Oil sheen in the water means food.
Sprinkle more and I come closer.
You touched me and I bolted.
I am too small to hurt you.
The bump pushed me half an arm off.
I swing back; I still mean to follow.

lines.zh: 你的靴底从我头上擦过。
lines.en: Your boot sole scraped over my head.
A bright scale came off my side.
The knock filled the water with bubbles.
I press against it and stay steady.
Do not crowd; there is no gap here.
I give way, then press back in.
My kind arrived; my stripes flash at it.
We swim abreast in the same rhythm.
I circle it, closing each turn.
It touches my flank with its snout.
The current is slow here; we can stay.

lines.zh: 我们一起钻过它的影子。
lines.en: We both slide through its shadow.

lines.zh: 它们的条纹和我的不一样。
lines.en: Their stripes differ from mine.
I follow it wherever it goes.
When we part, each swims alone.
Tiny eggs drift in the water.
This scrap of meat is mine.
I push with my mouth; too slippery.

lines.zh: 桶里还有东西，我进不去。
lines.en: There is more in the bucket; I cannot get in.

lines.zh: 我捡到一片鱼鳞，又丢了。
lines.en: I caught a scale and lost it.
Iron is too hard for my teeth.
It sank; I chased it two feet.
Too small to lodge in my teeth.
Carrying it slows me down.
Something is tangled on my fin.
I spit it out and look for something else.

lines.zh: 它背上有只小虫，我盯住了。
lines.en: A bug is on its back; I have it.
I pick the smallest one.
It moves; moving things can be eaten.
I do not chase big prey; I cannot catch it.
This target is right at my mouth.
My shoal is watching; I move first.

lines.zh: 那片寄生虫够我吃一顿。
lines.en: That patch of parasites is a meal.
I choose the spot at its fin base.
I avoid anything smelling too much of blood.
That one; I am going.

lines.zh: 我贴着它的侧线找位置。
lines.en: I slide along its lateral line to find a spot.
It has not noticed me; perfect.
I hover a hand's width off and steady.
A little closer and I can reach.
I approach from behind its fin.

lines.zh: 水流推向那边，我顺着去。
lines.en: The current pushes that way; I ride it.

lines.zh: 我的影子不能落在它眼里。
lines.en: My shadow must not fall in its eye.
When it flicks a fin, I pull back.
The angle is right; I open my mouth.
This one must be precise.
I pecked once and the bug was gone.
My teeth are small but open skin.
It bucked and threw me off.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，直到撕下来。
lines.en: I hold on until it tears free.
This much strength will not hurt you.
I bite only soft places.
One peck is not enough; again.
Water splashed; I back off to watch.
It did not react; I relax.
There is a faint taste of blood in my mouth.
I open my eyes in warm water.
The first big fish has not appeared.
My stripes have only just set.

lines.zh: 这里水浅，我先躲一会儿。
lines.en: Shallow here; I will hide a while.
My shoal swims out from behind the reef.
I must find something big to follow.

lines.zh: 水面的光让我看清方向。
lines.en: Light on the surface shows me the way.
I test a lap and find it fast.
There is a large shadow far off.
I am heading toward it.

lines.zh: 水面上的火烤得我鳞发紧。
lines.en: Fire on the surface tightened my scales.

lines.zh: 我被抛起来，又摔回水里。
lines.en: I was thrown up and fell back into the water.
My mouth is open but my gills have stopped.
The blast spun me twice around.

lines.zh: 有根尖东西擦过我的侧腹。
lines.en: Something sharp grazed my flank.

lines.zh: 这股冷让我的条纹发暗。
lines.en: This chill dulls my stripes.
Hungry enough to nibble its hide.

lines.zh: 雷在水面炸开，我翻白了。
lines.en: Lightning burst on the surface and I flashed white.
There is no water here; I cannot swim.
